title: React Tooling Applied Check
description: Apply React tooling knowledge to tricky build, environment, linting, source-map, and bundle-inspection scenarios.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: A developer puts `VITE_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` in a Vite React app. What is the problem?

options.text: The value can be bundled into browser-visible code
Vite ignores every variable with VITE_
The variable will be encrypted in the bundle
React will convert it to state

questions.explanation: Anything exposed to client code must be treated as public; secret keys belong on a server.

questions.prompt: Ops changes `VITE_API_BASE_URL` on a server after a static React bundle was already built, but the app still calls the old URL. Why?

options.text: Frontend build-time variables are baked into the generated assets
React caches environment variables in useState
Prettier removed the value
The browser blocks all environment variables

questions.explanation: Build-time configuration is substituted during the build; runtime changes need a different config delivery strategy.

questions.prompt: What should you check before publishing source maps for a production app? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Whether original source contains sensitive comments or secrets
Who can access the uploaded maps
Whether maps are needed for error monitoring
Whether source maps make passwords safe to expose

questions.explanation: Source maps can be valuable, but access and source contents need review. They do not make secrets safe.

questions.prompt: An app uses modern syntax that builds successfully, but older supported browsers fail at runtime because a missing API is not available. What tooling concept is involved?

options.text: Polyfills
JSX fragments
Git tags
ARIA labels

questions.explanation: Babel can transform syntax, but missing browser APIs may require polyfills depending on target support.

questions.prompt: During development, React Fast Refresh preserves component state after an edit. What common caveat should you remember?

options.text: Preserved state can hide initialization bugs until a full reload
It means production builds also hot reload
It disables Hooks rules
It replaces all tests

questions.explanation: Fast Refresh is helpful, but a full reload can reveal issues hidden by preserved local state.

questions.prompt: A bundle report shows a large date library in the main chunk used only on an admin route. What is a reasonable next step?

options.text: Consider route-level code splitting or a smaller dependency
Move the library into every component
Disable minification
Commit the bundle report as source code

questions.explanation: Build inspection should guide practical improvements such as splitting infrequent code or replacing heavy dependencies.

questions.prompt: ESLint and Prettier keep changing the same line back and forth. What is the likely issue?

options.text: Formatting-related lint rules are conflicting with Prettier configuration
React state is stale
The browser lacks source-map support
Vite cannot run ESLint

questions.explanation: Tooling should be configured so Prettier owns formatting and ESLint focuses on code issues.

questions.prompt: A Webpack app ships one huge initial bundle despite having rarely used admin pages. Which feature targets this issue?

options.text: Code splitting
Boolean props
CSS inheritance
CSRF tokens

questions.explanation: Code splitting can move less-used code out of the initial bundle.
